definitions.explanation: To cease to be visible or to exist; to vanish from sight.

definitions.gloss: to go out, to be extinguished
definitions.explanation: For a light, fire, or similar to stop burning or shining.

examples.notes: {消|き}えている describes the resulting state

examples.english: When I stayed up late at night, the lights in the neighboring houses went out one by one.

notes:
{消|き}える is an intransitive verb meaning to disappear or go out.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pair: {消|け}す (transitive - to turn off, to erase)
- Pattern: Xが{消|き}える

ASPECT (ている):
- {消|き}えている = is off, has disappeared (resulting state)
- Example: {電気|でんき}が{消|き}えている (the light is off)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気|でんき}が{消|き}える (light goes out)
- {火|ひ}が{消|き}える (fire goes out)
- {姿|すがた}が{消|き}える (figure disappears)
- {記憶|きおく}が{消|き}える (memory fades)
